text: Mawnii heewii moƴƴere On Jippinɗo Alqur'aanaare nden senndindiraynde hakkunde Goonga kan e meere nden e dow Jeyaaɗo Makko on e Nulaaɗo Makko on Muhammadu (yo Alla juulu e makko hisna); fii yo wonu Nulaaɗo faade sattafeere en ɗiɗo yimɓe ɓen e jinnaaji ɗin, ko o hulɓinayɗo ɓe immorde e Lepte Alla ɗen.
